subject: Discovery recap: Migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - pilot plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@shoply.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - pilot plan

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the time yesterday. Below is a concise recap and the pilot runbook so we're aligned on scope and timeline. Reply with any edits.

Key pain points you raised:
- High and rising token spend on OpenAI (2.5x increase over 6 months) leading to unpredictability.
- Vendor lock-in for embeddings + streaming features, limiting cost/perf options.
- Latency spikes affecting search/chat UX during peak traffic windows.
- Occasional hallucination on spec-generation prompts; needs measurable guardrails.

Current stack notes:
- OpenAI (chat + embeddings), Anthropic Claude for some assistant microservices.
- RAG using Elastic + OpenAI embeddings; some on-prem prompt storage and small fine-tunes.

Success criteria (mutually agreed):
1) 2x-5x reduction in per-token inference cost at target scale, or equivalent unit-economics improvements.
2) p50 latency < 200ms for short chat turns and improved p95 under load.
3) No regression on Shoply's top-20 prompts (you'll provide).
4) Security/compliance checklist satisfied (SOC 2, KMS options, retention controls).

Initial model shortlist for pilot: Llama 2 (quantized), Mistral-Instruct, Falcon 40B, and a smaller community mix for batch workloads. We will test embeddings parity and streaming behavior.

Compatibility checklist (must-haves):
- Token-level streaming and partial output support.
- Embeddings API compatible for cosine workflows.
- Stop sequences / structured output or function-like call patterns.
- Version pinning and determinism controls.

Pilot runbook (proposed):
- T0 (this week): Shoply shares top-20 prompts, traffic windows, and security contact (Shoply already sent usage CSV).
- Week 1 (pilot kickoff): Redwood spins up hosted trial for two variants (Llama2 quantized, Mistral-Instruct) and seeds test harness.
- Week 1: Baseline quality & latency report + initial cost projection.
- Week 3: Joint review; decide whether to extend to Dedicated trial or proceed with integration.

Next steps / asks:
- Action (Shoply): send top-20 prompt corpus and traffic windows by EOD Thu Jul 2 (Elena noted EOD Thu earlier). Provide Mallory Grant (mallory.grant@shoply.com) as the InfoSec contact.
- Action (Redwood): we will share the pilot pricing estimate and assign Amy Cho (security lead) as the contact in the security pack.
- Confirm kickoff: Tue Jul 13 1:00-1:45pm PT works for our team; Rishi will send the invite.

Attachments included: Shoply-current-usage.csv (you provided), Redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx, Redwood-security-pack.pdf.

If that captures everything I'll mark the kickoff and Rishi will follow up with the runbook and test harness.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
